name: Elevação de pernas estendidas na barra fixa
movement: Hanging straight-leg raise, keep knees straight, raise both legs forward toward horizontal, lower without swinging.
cue: Segure a barra com o corpo estável. Eleve as pernas estendidas à frente e retorne sem balançar.
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Original fitness animation sprite sheet. Exactly six sequential poses in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows grid with six equal square cells. One clothed athletic adult, fitted charcoal gray sportswear, realistic polished 3D educational anatomy, primary working muscles highlighted orange. White background, no text, no numbers, no watermark. Identical camera, body scale, equipment and stationary supports in every cell. Fixed foot contact and joint alignment. Full body and full equipment visible within each cell. Row-major order: start, quarter movement, midpoint, endpoint, returning, start. No camera mirroring, no added limbs. Movement: Hanging straight-leg raise, keep knees straight, raise both legs forward toward horizontal, lower without swinging.
